title: Radial pie menu with wedge warp
blurb: A radial pie menu of six HTML buttons drawn over a workspace card in one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas. Moving or flicking aims a selection beam, warps the active wedge with a spring and updates the card.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas draw a Blender-style radial pie menu of live HTML <button> items over a workspace card, complete with a frosted glass ring, directional selection beam, spring detent wedge stretch and calibrated updateElementGeometry() click hit boxes?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412 px, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass on one ElementGL context (0.91 MP, 7.3 MB), readPixels() confirms 0°, 120° and 240° beam quadrant shifts, and updateElementGeometry() hits moved and pulled buttons. Android Chrome 159 and check:jank stay not verified.
